I now have a complete picture of the implementation. The app is a minimal single-user bookmark manager with: save via URL + metadata preview (title/description only), edit, delete, tag assignment, tag-dropdown filtering, substring search (title/url/description/tags, case-insensitive), and duplicate detection. It lacks: notes, favicon/preview-image storage, unread/archive flags, bundles, sort selection, advanced search syntax, tag autocomplete, bulk actions, import/export, snapshots, and settings.
